Subject: Hyperband demo — follow up & next meeting

Hi Li —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Nova Clinic is prioritizing lower-latency inference for clinical note generation (especially shorter-turnaround chart updates) and needs predictable cost for peak clinic hours across APAC + EU. We covered integrations (FHIR push vs. S3 sync), data retention constraints, and the high-level SLAs you need.

Next step: technical deep-dive + demo with our Solutions Engineer to validate latency numbers and integration pattern. To make scheduling easier across your global team, I put together two options:

Option A — Single deep dive (90 min): a one-off UTC-friendly slot (best for mixed attendees).
Option B — Rotating weekly 60-min slots: we alternate between APAC-, EU-, and US-friendly windows so stakeholder attendance is maximized across follow-ups.

Can you share 2–3 target windows next week that work for you and Arjun (and whether you prefer Option A or Option B)? I attached a simple availability grid and a short demo brief — feel free to mark preferred rows.

Attendees we plan to include from Redwood: Karthik Iyer (Solutions Eng) and Monica Patel (Customer Success) — Karthik will lead the technical portion.

Deliverable after the call: mutual action plan with acceptance criteria for pilot and a bandwidth estimate.

Thanks — look forward to locking something in.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 415-555-0182

Appreciate the clear recap. Arjun and I reviewed both options — we prefer the rotating weekly slots (Option B) so our on-call clinicians and platform engineers can alternate attending without blocking a single sweet spot.

- Week A: Tue 2027-02-23, 08:30–09:30 SGT (APAC-friendly)
- Week B: Tue 2027-03-02, 15:00–16:00 SGT (this aligns with late-morning CET; our EU lead can join)
- Week C: Tue 2027-03-09, 23:00–00:00 SGT (this maps to morning PST — tough but sometimes required for US partners)

If you can confirm which of those you can cover and whether Karthik can take one of the APAC slots, we can lock recurring invites.
